<p>最近对kolla部署的Openstack做了一些调研，尤其是对mariadb galera集群自身的高可用机制，以及haproxy，proxysql组件对mariadb galera集群的负载均衡方法、支持程度进行了一些分析和探索。我把这次调研的收获总结成了知识型输出，希望可以给有相关需求的同行一些参考。</p>
<h1 id="mariadb-cluster概览">mariadb cluster概览</h1>
<p>mariadb 集群有多种模式，针对不同的业务场景，各有所长。</p>
<table>

</tr>

<tr>

<td>同步复制，强一致性</td>

<td>✅ 是</td>
</tr>

<h1 id="mariadb-galera集群简介">mariadb galera集群简介</h1>
<h2 id="什么是galera集群">什么是galera集群</h2>
<p>Galera 是 MariaDB 官方推荐的 Multi Master，同步复制集群​​方案，主要面向需要​强一致性和​​高可用​​的 OLTP（Online Transaction Processing）场景。</p>
<p>kolla 在 openstack 环境部署时，默认将 galera 作为后端数据库集群方案。官方建议 galera 集群至少需要三个 mariadb 节点。</p>
<div align="center">
<img data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1485868/202511/1485868-20251118223721911-1091858960.png" class="lazyload">
</div>
<h2 id="galera集群同步机制简介">galera集群同步机制简介</h2>
<p>从应用向 galera 集群发起数据请求开始，直至完成事务提交，应用与 galera 集群的交互，以及 galera 集群的同步机制可简单概括为：</p>
<div class="mermaid">sequenceDiagram
    participant Client as Client &lt;br&gt;（Client_A, Client_B, Client_C）
    participant mariadb_A as mariadb_A
    participant mariadb_B as mariadb_B
    participant mariadb_C as mariadb_C
    participant GCS as gloabl GCS (Group Communication System)&lt;br&gt;（mariadb_A, mariadb_B, mariadb_C together）

    Note over Client,mariadb_C: 阶段一：客户端并发请求多个节点执行更新
    Client-&gt;&gt;mariadb_A: UPDATE users SET name='Tom' WHERE id=1
    Client-&gt;&gt;mariadb_B: UPDATE users SET name='Jerry' WHERE id=1
    Client-&gt;&gt;mariadb_C: UPDATE users SET name='Lucy' WHERE id=2

    Note over mariadb_A,mariadb_C: 阶段二：各节点生成写集并广播
    mariadb_A-&gt;&gt;mariadb_A: 生成写集A
    mariadb_B-&gt;&gt;mariadb_B: 生成写集B
    mariadb_C-&gt;&gt;mariadb_C: 生成写集C
    mariadb_A-&gt;&gt;GCS: GCS广播写集A
    mariadb_B-&gt;&gt;GCS: 广播写集B
    mariadb_C-&gt;&gt;GCS: 广播写集C
    

    Note over GCS: 阶段三：全局顺序排序（Total Order Isolation，TOI）&lt;br&gt;确保各节点按同一顺序处理并发事务
    GCS-&gt;&gt;GCS: 分配全局seqno: A=101, B=102, C=103
    GCS--&gt;&gt;mariadb_A: 分发全局seqno [A=101, B=102, C=103]
    GCS--&gt;&gt;mariadb_B: 分发全局seqno [A=101, B=102, C=103]
    GCS--&gt;&gt;mariadb_C: 分发全局seqno [A=101, B=102, C=103]

    Note over mariadb_A,mariadb_C: 阶段四：各节点按顺序执行冲突检测
    mariadb_A-&gt;&gt;mariadb_A: 依据seqno顺序处理
    mariadb_A-&gt;&gt;mariadb_A: 1.提交A
    mariadb_A-&gt;&gt;mariadb_A: 2.B冲突，拒绝 
    mariadb_A-&gt;&gt;mariadb_A: 3.提交C
    mariadb_B-&gt;&gt;mariadb_B: 与mariadb_A逻辑一致
    mariadb_C-&gt;&gt;mariadb_C: 与mariadb_A逻辑一致

    Note over Client,mariadb_C: 阶段五：返回结果
    mariadb_A--&gt;&gt;Client: 事务 A 成功
    mariadb_B--&gt;&gt;Client: 事务 B 失败（冲突）
    mariadb_C--&gt;&gt;Client: 事务 C 成功
</div><ul>
<li>客户端A、B、C分别同时连接 mariadb_A，mariadb_B，mariadb_C，并发写操作</li>
<li>各mariadb节点分别生成对应事务的写集（WriteSet）A，写集B，写集C。例如写集A的内容<pre><code class="language-json">{
  "transaction_id": "a1b2c3d4-5678",
  "global_seqno": 1024,          // 临时序列号
  "source_id": "mariadb_A",      // 发起节点
  "timestamp": 1630000000.123,   // 时间戳
  
  "schema": {
    "name": "users",            // 表名
    "version": 3                // 表结构版本号
  },
  
  "rows": [
    {
      "key": {"id": 1},        // 主键值
      "action": "UPDATE",      // 操作类型
      "before": {"name": "LiLei"},  // 修改前的值
      "after": {"name": "Tom"},     // 修改后的值
      "version": 5                  // 行版本号（用于冲突检测），行被修改后递增1
    }
  ],
  
  "dependencies": [] // 依赖的前序事务seqno
} 
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>写集包含了事务写操作的关键信息</li>
<li>写集用于向集群广播，通告此次sql操作的影响范围。不是原始sql语句，而是哪些数据将被修改的相关信息</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>写集广播。各自mariadb节点使用 Galera 的 GCS（Group Communication System） 将各自写集广播</li>
<li>事务全局排序。
<ul>
<li>GCS 使用分布式一致性协议（类似 Paxos，galera称为Virtually Synchronous Replication）在集群协商事务的全局执行顺序</li>
<li>为多个并发事务（A, B, C）分配全局唯一的，严格递增的 seqno，从而达成所有事务的全局执行顺序</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>事务认证（事务冲突检测）与事务提交。
<ul>
<li>如果当前待提交事务与并发的，已提交的事务无冲突，则提交该事务。否则事务拒绝，并返回 <strong>deadlock</strong></li>
<li>各节点按照全局 seqno 按序提交对应事务</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>在 ​​Galera Cluster​​ 的多主架构中，事务的最终结果​不取决于事务的发起时间​​，而是由 ​​GCS（Group Communication System）的全局排序（Total Ordering）​​ 决定</strong>。</p>
<h2 id="galera集群的优缺点">galera集群的优缺点</h2>
<p>主要优点：</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>集群模式</th>
<th>类型</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>Multi-Master架构 ​</td>
<td>所有节点均可处理读写请求</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>同步复制</td>
<td>采用写集复制，通过组通信协议（GCS）进行同步提交</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>​强一致性​</td>
<td>​所有事务在提交前必须经过全局认证、排序、冲突检测，最终实现一致性，也意味着所有节点数据对等</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>无单点故障</td>
<td>任意节点宕机不影响集群整体可用性</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>新节点自动同步</td>
<td>新节点可以自动加入集群，通过 State Snapshot Transfer (SST) 或 Incremental State Transfer (IST) 同步状态</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>主要缺点：</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>集群模式</th>
<th>类型</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>写入冲突导致回滚​</td>
<td>并发修改相同一行的数据会被检测为冲突，需要应用自行处理</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>事务延迟依赖最慢节点</td>
<td>所有节点在事务提交前需达成共识，进行全局排序和冲突检测造成事务延迟</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>写入水平扩展受限 ​</td>
<td>事务广播同步，写性能受限于最慢节点，且每个节点都互为副本，无法通过增加节点提升写吞吐</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="相同行事务并发更新">相同行事务并发更新</h3>
<ul>
<li>表结构</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-sql">MariaDB [test]&gt; desc tmp;
+-------------+--------------+------+-----+---------------------+----------------+
| Field       | Type         | Null | Key | Default             | Extra          |
+-------------+--------------+------+-----+---------------------+----------------+
| id          | int(11)      | NO   | PRI | NULL                | auto_increment |
| data        | varchar(255) | YES  |     | NULL                |                |
| created_at  | timestamp    | NO   |     | current_timestamp() |                |
| data_origin | varchar(255) | YES  |     | NULL                |                |
+-------------+--------------+------+-----+---------------------+----------------+
4 rows in set (0.003 sec)  
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>并发冲突demo</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-python">import uuid
import pymysql
import threading

DB_HOSTS = ["18.242.143.30", "18.242.143.31", "18.242.143.32"]
DB_USER = "root"
DB_PASS = "nuage#2345"
DB_NAME = "test"

def write_to_db(ip, data, data_origin, row_id):
    try:
        conn = pymysql.connect(host = ip, user = DB_USER, password = DB_PASS, database = DB_NAME)
        cursor = conn.cursor()

        # 事务开启
        cursor.execute("BEGIN;")

        # 更新插入
        cursor.execute("""
        INSERT INTO tmp (id, data, data_origin) 
            VALUES (%s, %s, %s)
            ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE data = VALUES(data), data_origin = VALUES(data_origin);""", 
            (row_id, data, data_origin))

        # 事务提交
        conn.commit()

        print(f"[{ip}] ✅ Update Success")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[{ip}] ❌ Update Error: {e}")
    finally:
        conn.close()

thread1 = threading.Thread(target=write_to_db, args=(DB_HOSTS[0], str(uuid.uuid4())[:8], 'value_from_30', 3))
thread2 = threading.Thread(target=write_to_db, args=(DB_HOSTS[1], str(uuid.uuid4())[:8], 'value_from_31', 3))
thread3 = threading.Thread(target=write_to_db, args=(DB_HOSTS[2], str(uuid.uuid4())[:8], 'value_from_32', 3))

# 创建并发线程
thread1.start()
thread2.start()
thread3.start()

thread1.join()
thread2.join()
thread3.join()
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>结果输出</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell">[18.242.143.31] ✅ Update Insert Success
[18.242.143.30] ❌ Update Insert Error: (1213, 'Deadlock found when trying to get lock; try restarting transaction')
[18.242.143.32] ❌ Update Insert Error: (1213, 'Deadlock found when trying to get lock; try restarting transaction')
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-sql">MariaDB [test]&gt; select * from tmp;
+----+----------+---------------------+---------------+
| id | data     | created_at          | data_origin   |
+----+----------+---------------------+---------------+
|  3 | 04d2ec9a | 2025-08-11 13:58:07 | value_from_31 |
+----+----------+---------------------+---------------+
2 rows in set (0.001 sec)
</code></pre>
<p>或者其它结果：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">[18.242.143.32] ✅ Update Insert Success
[18.242.143.31] ❌ Update Insert Error: (1213, 'Deadlock found when trying to get lock; try restarting transaction')
[18.242.143.30] ❌ Update Insert Error: (1213, 'Deadlock found when trying to get lock; try restarting transaction')
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-sql">MariaDB [test]&gt; select * from tmp;
+----+----------+---------------------+---------------+
| id | data     | created_at          | data_origin   |
+----+----------+---------------------+---------------+
|  3 | f0d31a50 | 2025-08-11 13:58:07 | value_from_32 |
+----+----------+---------------------+---------------+
2 rows in set (0.001 sec)
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>虽然 galera 支持多节点并发写，但是相同行的并发操作还是会受限。</li>
<li>相同行的并发结果随机，取决于谁的事务先到达。但是最后，所有节点一定会按照协商的全局顺序应用并发事务，保证所有节点数据的一致性。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="相同行事务串行更新">相同行事务串行更新</h3>
<p>将线程创建方式从并发改为串行启动：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">thread1.start()
thread1.join()

thread2.start()
thread2.join()

thread3.start()
thread3.join()
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>结果输出</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell">[18.242.143.30] ✅ Update Insert Success
[18.242.143.31] ✅ Update Insert Success
[18.242.143.32] ✅ Update Insert Success
</code></pre>
<p>不再出现相同行并发事务冲突问题。</p>
<h3 id="不同行事务并发更新">不同行事务并发更新</h3>
<p>并发更新插入，操作不同行</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">DB_HOSTS = ["18.242.143.30", "18.242.143.31", "18.242.143.32"]

thread1 = threading.Thread(target=write_to_db, args=(DB_HOSTS[0], str(uuid.uuid4())[:8], 'value_from_30', 3))
thread2 = threading.Thread(target=write_to_db, args=(DB_HOSTS[1], str(uuid.uuid4())[:8], 'value_from_31', 4))
thread3 = threading.Thread(target=write_to_db, args=(DB_HOSTS[2], str(uuid.uuid4())[:8], 'value_from_32', 5))
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>结果输出</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell">[18.242.143.32] ✅ Update Insert Success
[18.242.143.31] ✅ Update Insert Success
[18.242.143.30] ✅ Update Insert Success
</code></pre>
<h2 id="galera三节点集群搭建">galera三节点集群搭建</h2>
<ul>
<li>配置文件举例</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-ini">[mysqld]
bind-address=18.242.143.30      # 监听地址
log_bin=mysql-bin
binlog_format=ROW
default_storage_engine=InnoDB   # galera只支持InnoDB引擎
innodb_autoinc_lock_mode=2

wsrep_on=ON                                                     # 启用galare插件
wsrep_cluster_name="galera-cluster"                             # galera集群名称
wsrep_cluster_address="gcomm://mariadb-1,mariadb-2,mariadb-3"   # galera集群地址列表
wsrep_provider=/usr/lib64/galera/libgalera_smm.so

wsrep_node_name="mariadb-1"             # 当前节点名称
wsrep_node_address="18.242.143.30"      # 当前节点通信地址

wsrep_sst_method=mariabackup            # sst(State Snapshot Transfer)同步默认方法。不锁表，写入不阻塞
wsrep_sst_auth="sstuser:nuage#2345"     # sst认证凭据

wsrep_slave_threads=4
max_connections=10000
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>其余两节点配置只需要修改 bind-address ， wsrep_node_name 和 wsrep_node_address</li>
<li>当集群是第一次启动，可任选其中一个节点执行：<strong>galera_new_cluster</strong>
<ul>
<li>galera_new_cluster 生成集群uuid标识，后续加入的节点都使用该ID</li>
<li>galera_new_cluster 跳过集群成员检查。常规启动时（systemctl start mariadb），本节点会尝试连接 wsrep_cluster_address 中的其他节点，但是 galera_new_cluster 会跳过该步骤</li>
<li>最先启动的节点成为 Donor 节点（数据源节点）。后续节点加入时，会从该节点触发 SST（State Snapshot Transfer，全量同步）或 IST（Incremental State Transfer，增量同步）</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>主节点启动成功后，其余节点执行：<strong>systemctl start mariadb</strong> 即可</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="galera集群节点数规则">galera集群节点数规则</h2>
<p>mariabd 官方建议 galera 集群至少应由三个节点组成。</p>
<p>galera 集群需要遵循多数派规则：</p>
<ul>
<li>剩余节点数可以构成多数派（剩下的节点数需要大于原始总集群的50%），则该集群可以正常工作</li>
<li>剩余节点数不满足多数派，则该集群终止写入能力。</li>
</ul>
<p>假设集群由两个几点构成：</p>
<ul>
<li>正常：Node1 ↔ Node2 正常通信</li>
<li>异常场景：网络故障导致两节点相互失联
<ul>
<li>Node1 认为 Node2 挂了</li>
<li>Node2 认为 Node1 挂了</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p>如果没有多数派规则，两个节点都会以为自己是唯一存活节点，于是都可以接受写请求，最终造成两边数据非一致，导致脑裂。所以，为了尽可能避免脑裂，galera 在仲裁规则里规定：<strong>剩下的节点必须获得多数派票数，才能成为 Primary，才能继续写，否则终止写入，状态切换为 Non-Primary</strong>。有如下集群多数派计算公式和表格：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">majority = [节点总数 / 2] + 1 
</code></pre>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center">集群节点数</th>
<th style="text-align: center">需要在线的最少节点数（majority）</th>
<th style="text-align: center">允许故障数</th>
<th style="text-align: center">故障容忍率</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center">1</td>
<td style="text-align: center">1</td>
<td style="text-align: center">0</td>
<td style="text-align: center">0%</td>
<td>孤立节点，非集群</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center">2</td>
<td style="text-align: center">2</td>
<td style="text-align: center">0</td>
<td style="text-align: center">0%</td>
<td>任意一个挂了，剩下的一个失去多数派，集群进入只读状态，即 <strong>Non-Primary</strong></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center">3</td>
<td style="text-align: center">2</td>
<td style="text-align: center">1</td>
<td style="text-align: center">33%</td>
<td>允许一个节点故障，剩下两个还能继续写</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center">4</td>
<td style="text-align: center">3</td>
<td style="text-align: center">1</td>
<td style="text-align: center">25%</td>
<td>与3节点集群一样，只允许一个节点故障</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center">5</td>
<td style="text-align: center">3</td>
<td style="text-align: center">2</td>
<td style="text-align: center">40%</td>
<td>允许两个节点故障</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center">6</td>
<td style="text-align: center">4</td>
<td style="text-align: center">2</td>
<td style="text-align: center">33%</td>
<td>与5节点集群一样，只允许两个节点故障</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>表格反映了一些事实：</p>
<ul>
<li>奇数个节点的允许故障数与 +1 的偶数个节点允许故障数相同</li>
<li>奇数个节点的故障容忍率比 +1 的偶数个节点故障容忍率要高</li>
</ul>
<p>为了避免资源浪费，官方建议，galera 集群建议节点数应为奇数个。并且，三个节点是 galera 最小安全配置。</p>
<h2 id="galera集群扩容">galera集群扩容</h2>
<p>有当前集群信息：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">MariaDB [test]&gt; SHOW STATUS LIKE 'wsrep_cluster_size';
+--------------------+-------+
| Variable_name      | Value |
+--------------------+-------+
| wsrep_cluster_size | 3     |
+--------------------+-------+
1 row in set (0.001 sec)
</code></pre>
<p>新增一个 mariadb 节点，从三节点集群扩容至四节点集群。配置：</p>
<pre><code class="language-ini">[mysqld]
bind-address=18.242.143.33      # 监听地址
log_bin=mysql-bin
binlog_format=ROW
default_storage_engine=InnoDB   # galera只支持InnoDB引擎
innodb_autoinc_lock_mode=2

wsrep_on=ON                                                     # 启用galare插件
wsrep_cluster_name="galera-cluster"                             # galera集群名称
wsrep_cluster_address="gcomm://mariadb-1,mariadb-2,mariadb-3"   # galera集群地址列表
wsrep_provider=/usr/lib64/galera/libgalera_smm.so

wsrep_node_name="mariadb-4"             # 当前节点名称
wsrep_node_address="18.242.143.33"      # 当前节点通信地址

wsrep_sst_method=mariabackup            # sst(State Snapshot Transfer)同步默认方法。不锁表，写入不阻塞
wsrep_sst_auth="sstuser:nuage#2345"     # sst认证凭据

wsrep_slave_threads=4
max_connections=10000
</code></pre>
<p>在新增节点执行：<strong>systemctl start mariadb</strong> 即可。摘取新增节点的关键日志信息：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">
# 连接到集群中的其它节点
2025-08-12 14:25:25 0 [Note] WSREP: (21b01b3d-a887, 'tcp://0.0.0.0:4567') connection established to 3afca15d-bd74 tcp://18.242.143.31:4567
2025-08-12 14:25:25 0 [Note] WSREP: (21b01b3d-a887, 'tcp://0.0.0.0:4567') connection established to 3cfa0384-b2c4 tcp://18.242.143.30:4567
2025-08-12 14:25:25 0 [Note] WSREP: (21b01b3d-a887, 'tcp://0.0.0.0:4567') connection established to 134e4245-aba6 tcp://18.242.143.32:4567

# 当前集群状态为 Primary，满足多数派规则
2025-08-12 14:25:26 0 [Note] WSREP: New COMPONENT: primary = yes, bootstrap = no, my_idx = 1, memb_num = 4

# SST同步成功。SST过程开销 14s
2025-08-12 14:25:26 2 [Note] WSREP: GCache history reset: 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:0 -&gt; ec75dcca-711c-11f0-9611-ef90f88adb5e:918
WSREP_SST: [INFO] Proceeding with SST (20250812 14:25:27.481)
2025-08-12 14:25:39 0 [Note] WSREP: 0.0 (mariadb-3): State transfer to 1.0 (mariadb-4) complete.
2025-08-12 14:25:40 3 [Note] WSREP: SST received

# IST补充未同步事务
2025-08-12 14:25:40 0 [Note] WSREP: ####### IST current seqno initialized to 874
2025-08-12 14:25:40 0 [Note] WSREP: Receiving IST... 0.0% (0/45 events) complete.
2025-08-12 14:25:40 2 [Note] WSREP: IST received: ec75dcca-711c-11f0-9611-ef90f88adb5e:918

# 集群加入成功，新加入节点后续可以参与多数派投票和接受读写
025-08-12 14:25:40 2 [Note] WSREP: Server status change joined -&gt; synced
</code></pre>
<p>新节点成功加入集群后，集群扩容成功</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">MariaDB [(none)]&gt; SHOW STATUS LIKE 'wsrep_cluster_size';
+--------------------+-------+
| Variable_name      | Value |
+--------------------+-------+
| wsrep_cluster_size | 4     |
+--------------------+-------+
1 row in set (0.002 sec)
</code></pre>
<h2 id="mariadb节点正常退出">mariadb节点正常退出</h2>
<p>有当前 galera 集群信息：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">MariaDB [test]&gt; SHOW STATUS LIKE 'wsrep_cluster_size';
+--------------------+-------+
| Variable_name      | Value |
+--------------------+-------+
| wsrep_cluster_size | 3     |
+--------------------+-------+
1 row in set (0.002 sec)

# 任意节点的集群状态都是 Primary，代表可读可写
MariaDB [test]&gt; SHOW STATUS LIKE 'wsrep_cluster_status';
+----------------------+---------+
| Variable_name        | Value   |
+----------------------+---------+
| wsrep_cluster_status | Primary |
+----------------------+---------+
1 row in set (0.002 sec)
</code></pre>
<p>任意节点通过：systemctl stop mariadb，逐步停止。</p>
<ul>
<li>停止 18.242.143.30 节点</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-sql">MariaDB [(none)]&gt; SHOW STATUS LIKE 'wsrep_cluster_size';
+--------------------+-------+
| Variable_name      | Value |
+--------------------+-------+
| wsrep_cluster_size | 2     |
+--------------------+-------+
1 row in set (0.001 sec)

MariaDB [(none)]&gt; show status like 'wsrep_cluster_status';
+----------------------+---------+
| Variable_name        | Value   |
+----------------------+---------+
| wsrep_cluster_status | Primary |
+----------------------+---------+
1 row in set (0.001 sec)
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>停止 18.242.143.31 节点</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-sql">MariaDB [(none)]&gt; SHOW STATUS LIKE 'wsrep_cluster_size';
+--------------------+-------+
| Variable_name      | Value |
+--------------------+-------+
| wsrep_cluster_size | 1     |
+--------------------+-------+
1 row in set (0.001 sec)

MariaDB [(none)]&gt;
MariaDB [(none)]&gt; show status like 'wsrep_cluster_status';
+----------------------+---------+
| Variable_name        | Value   |
+----------------------+---------+
| wsrep_cluster_status | Primary |
+----------------------+---------+
1 row in set (0.001 sec)
</code></pre>
<p>节点逐步协商退出，集群的规模逐步减小，直至剩余最后一个节点。因为集群规模也退化为1个节点，也满足 galera 集群多数派运行规则（因为集群规模也缩减至1），所以可以继续对外提供读写服务。</p>
<h2 id="mariadb节点异常退出">mariadb节点异常退出</h2>
<p>3节点集群，异常退出两个 mariadb 节点，得到如下集群状态：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">MariaDB [(none)]&gt; SHOW STATUS LIKE 'wsrep_cluster_size';
+--------------------+-------+
| Variable_name      | Value |
+--------------------+-------+
| wsrep_cluster_size | 1     |
+--------------------+-------+
1 row in set (0.002 sec)

MariaDB [(none)]&gt;
MariaDB [(none)]&gt; show status like 'wsrep_cluster_status';
+----------------------+-------------+
| Variable_name        | Value       |
+----------------------+-------------+
| wsrep_cluster_status | non-Primary |
+----------------------+-------------+
1 row in set (0.002 sec)
</code></pre>
<p>galera节点异常退出，导致最后的节点认为集群规模还是3节点，按照 galera 集群多数派运行规则：</p>
<ul>
<li>3节点集群至少需要两个节点正常运行</li>
<li>1个节点不再满足大多数（&gt;50%）</li>
</ul>
<p>所以剩余的唯一的 galera 节点被禁止写，只可读。</p>
<h2 id="galera集群整体停机后的重新恢复">galera集群整体停机后的重新恢复</h2>
<p>先看文件：/var/lib/mysql/grastate.dat</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">[root@mariadb-1 ~]# cat /var/lib/mysql/grastate.dat
# GALERA saved state
version: 2.1
uuid:    ec75dcca-711c-11f0-9611-ef90f88adb5e   # 集群的全局唯一标识符（​​Cluster UUID​​）
seqno:   -1                                     # 节点最后提交的事务序列号（​​Sequence Number​​）
safe_to_bootstrap: 0                            # 标记节点是否可以​安全引导集群​​（即作为第一个启动节点）。 0：​​禁止​​自动引导；1：​​允许​​引导
</code></pre>
<p>galera整体停机分为两种情况，一种是所有节点按序退出；另一种是所有节点异常宕机。</p>
<h3 id="所有节点按序退出的集群恢复">所有节点按序退出的集群恢复</h3>
<p>所有节点按序退出，seqno 会被每个节点更新为最后的事务ID，safe_to_bootstrap 会被最后退出的节点置为 1。正常退出的集群恢复：</p>
<ul>
<li>找到 safe_to_bootstrap 为 1 的节点，执行：<strong>galera_new_cluster</strong></li>
<li>如果找不到 safe_to_bootstrap 为 1 的节点，找到 seqno 最大的节点，将该节点的 safe_to_bootstrap 置为 1，再执行：<strong>galera_new_cluster</strong></li>
<li>其它节点执行：systemctl start mariadb 即可</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="所有节点异常宕机的集群恢复">所有节点异常宕机的集群恢复</h3>
<p>galera集群所有节点异常宕机，所有节点的 grastate.dat 文件都不会被更新，将出现无引导恢复节点的情形。如果直接通过重启服务：<strong>systemctl restart mariadb</strong> ，任意节点执行重启，最后都会报错，因为节点启动时会先去连接其它 galera 节点，但此时无一节点存活，启动失败。</p>
<pre><code class="language-text">2025-08-12 17:34:47 0 [Note] WSREP: gcomm: connecting to group 'galera-cluster', peer 'mariadb-1:,mariadb-2:,mariadb-3:'
2025-08-12 17:34:47 0 [Note] WSREP: (d51c9e68-9e44, 'tcp://0.0.0.0:4567') Found matching local endpoint for a connection, blacklisting address tcp://18.242.143.30:4567
2025-08-12 17:34:47 0 [Note] WSREP: Failed to establish connection: Connection refused
2025-08-12 17:34:47 0 [Note] WSREP: Failed to establish connection: Connection refused
</code></pre>
<p>如果在任意节点修改 grastate.dat 的 safe_to_bootstrap = 1，再执行 galera_new_cluster，存在数据丢失的风险。</p>
<p>因此，这种场景的恢复，需要人工干预：</p>
<ul>
<li>每个 mariabd 节点都需要执行一次：mariadbd --wsrep_recover --user=mysql，目的是得到当前节点停机前的最后一个事务ID。在 mariadb log 文件查看命令行信息
<ul>
<li>其中一个异常停机节点有信息：</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell">2025-08-20 11:38:01 0 [Note] Server socket created on IP: '18.242.143.30'.
2025-08-20 11:38:01 0 [Note] WSREP: Recovered position: 80d99892-7d76-11f0-9233-6b6b37ab0652:4
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>另一个异常停机节点有信息：</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell">2025-08-20 13:44:13 0 [Note] Server socket created on IP: '18.242.143.32'.
2025-08-20 13:44:13 0 [Note] WSREP: Recovered position: 80d99892-7d76-11f0-9233-6b6b37ab0652:6
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>将ID最大节点的 grastate.dat 的 safe_to_bootstrap 设置为 1</li>
<li>在该节点执行：galera_new_cluster</li>
<li>主节点启动完毕，其它节点依次执行：systemctl start mariadb</li>
</ul>
<p>当然，也可以通过脚本包装以上命令，实现自动恢复。</p>
<h1 id="galera集群在openstack中的应用">galera集群在openstack中的应用</h1>
<h3 id="什么是haproxy">什么是haproxy</h3>
<p>​HAProxy​​（High Availability Proxy）是一款开源的高性能 TCP/HTTP 负载均衡器​。</p>
<div align="center">
<img data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1485868/202511/1485868-20251118231455377-1265824695.png" class="lazyload">
</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>特性</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>高性能​</td>
<td>单进程，事件驱动（I/O多路复用），支持每秒数十万请求</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>多协议支持​</td>
<td>TCP（四层）、HTTP（七层）、SSL/TLS、WebSocket、gRPC</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>​​健康检查​</td>
<td>主动监测后端服务器状态，自动剔除故障节点</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>负载均衡算法​</td>
<td>轮询（Round Robin）、最小连接（Least Connections）、源 IP 哈希等</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="kolla-haproxy-galera环境节点信息">kolla haproxy-galera环境节点信息</h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>节点</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>18.242.143.10</td>
<td>control-1</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>18.242.143.11</td>
<td>control-2</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>18.242.143.12</td>
<td>control-3</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>18.242.143.100</td>
<td>floating ip, control-3</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="kolla-haproxy-galera框架">kolla haproxy-galera框架</h3>
<p>kolla 部署的 openstack，haproxy 默认 enable，表示将使用 haproxy 代理并负载均衡各种 openstack 应用请求。例如有如下配置：</p>
<ul>
<li>haproxy 对 neutron-server 的代理配置：cat /etc/kolla/haproxy/services.d/neutron-server.cfg 。haproxy 对 openstack 核心组件都是使用 http 代理模式，应用请求默认使用轮询分发到各节点</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell">frontend neutron_server_front
    mode http
    http-request del-header X-Forwarded-Proto
    option httplog
    option forwardfor
    http-request set-header X-Forwarded-Proto https if { ssl_fc }
    bind 18.242.143.100:9696  # floating IP
    default_backend neutron_server_back

backend neutron_server_back
    mode http
    server control-60 18.242.143.10:9696 check inter 2000 rise 2 fall 5
    server control-61 18.242.143.11:9696 check inter 2000 rise 2 fall 5
    server control-62 18.242.143.12:9696 check inter 2000 rise 2 fall 5
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>neutron-server组件本身有关数据库访问的配置</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell">[database]
connection = mysql+pymysql://neutron:aYNsc0NKcGKDvhyYEQiiibGp18r6YhJRl9722sSv@18.242.143.100:3306/neutron   # 访问的是 18.242.143.100:3306
connection_recycle_time = 10
max_pool_size = 1
max_retries = -1
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>haproxy 对 mariabd 的代理配置
<ul>
<li>haproxy 不支持 sql 解析</li>
<li>haproxy 对 mariadb 代理使用tcp模式</li>
<li>kolla openstack，haproxy 将其它 mariadb 节点作为备份节点，所有应用请求均代理到主 mariadb 节点。<strong>一主多备模式</strong>，无负载均衡</li>
<li>kolla openstack，haproxy 检查的端口是：4569，不是 mariadb 默认服务端口3306</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell">frontend mariadb_front
    mode tcp
    option clitcpka
    timeout client 3600s
    option tcplog
    bind 18.242.143.100:3306    # 监听 vip：18.242.143.100
    default_backend mariadb_back

backend mariadb_back
    mode tcp                # TCP 代理
    option srvtcpka
    timeout server 3600s    # 后端空闲3600s后断开连接
    option httpchk          # http检查
    server control-1 18.242.143.10:3306 check port 4569 inter 2000 rise 2 fall 5            # 被haproxy标记为master。每 2 秒检查一次，2 次成功标记为健康，5 次失败标记为宕机
    server control-2 18.242.143.11:3306 check port 4569 inter 2000 rise 2 fall 5 backup     # 被haproxy标记为slave。每 2 秒检查一次，2 次成功标记为健康，5 次失败标记为宕机
    server control-3 18.242.143.12:3306 check port 4569 inter 2000 rise 2 fall 5 backup     # 被haproxy标记为slave。每 2 秒检查一次，2 次成功标记为健康，5 次失败标记为宕机
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-shell">$ netstat -ntpl | grep 3306
tcp        0      0 18.242.143.100:3306     0.0.0.0:*               LISTEN      513998/haproxy
tcp        0      0 18.242.143.10:3306      0.0.0.0:*               LISTEN      3883762/mariadbd
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>举例说明客户端通过 horizen 发起 vm 实例查询。为了方便展示，图中的两个 <strong>haproxy</strong> 其实为同一个进程。
<ul>
<li>客户端通过访问 node-1 的 floating IP 打开 dashboard</li>
<li>horizen 向 nova 发起查询，查询指向主节点的 haproxy 代理，haproxy 通过轮询分配了 node-2 的 nova</li>
<li>node-2 的 nova 请求网络信息，向 neutron 发起查询请求，请求指向主节点的 haproxy 代理，haproxy 通过轮询分配了 node-3 的 neutron</li>
<li>node-3 的 neutron 向 galera 集群发起查询请求，请求指向主节点的 haproxy 代理，haproxy 根据配置，指定向 galera 的 mariadb 主节点发起查询请求</li>
<li>node-1 的 mariadb 响应查询</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<div align="center">
<img data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1485868/202511/1485868-20251118231648919-102846822.png" class="lazyload">
</div>
<h3 id="haproxy高可用">haproxy高可用</h3>
<h4 id="haproxy对mariadb的健康检查">haproxy对mariadb的健康检查</h4>
<p>haproxy 通过与 mariadb_clustercheck 容器监听的 4569 端口交互，实现对 mariadb 节点的健康检查。</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell"># mariadb监听的是3306和4567端口
$ netstat -ntpl | grep mariadb
tcp        0      0 18.242.143.10:4567      0.0.0.0:*               LISTEN      1136220/mariadbd
tcp        0      0 18.242.143.10:3306      0.0.0.0:*               LISTEN      1136220/mariadbd
$
# kolla部署了mariadb和mariadb_clustercheck容器
$ docker ps | grep mariadb
c0f9b3e0876a   quay.io/openstack.kolla/mariadb-server:2024.1-rocky-9              "dumb-init -- kolla_…"   3 days ago    Up 3 days (healthy)                mariadb
8c038cb7f60e   quay.io/openstack.kolla/mariadb-clustercheck:2024.1-rocky-9        "dumb-init --single-…"   5 weeks ago   Up 3 days                          mariadb_clustercheck
$
$ netstat -ntpl | grep 4569
tcp        0      0 18.242.143.10:4569      0.0.0.0:*               LISTEN      1136238/socat
$
# 端口4569是 mariadb_clustercheck 监听的
$ docker exec -it mariadb_clustercheck lsof -i :4569 -P
COMMAND PID USER   FD   TYPE    DEVICE SIZE/OFF NODE NAME
socat     7 root    6u  IPv4 183999368      0t0  TCP control-1:4569 (LISTEN)
$
</code></pre>
<p><strong>synced</strong> 状态代表该节点可正常处理读写请求，是一个健康的 mariadb 节点。</p>
<div align="center">
<img data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1485868/202511/1485868-20251118231752026-1782160722.png" class="lazyload">
</div>
<p>当某个 mariadb 节点离线，haproxy 得到状态是：<strong>not synced</strong>，表示 mariadb 节点异常，从而不会再将流量分配到该节点。</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">$ curl --noproxy "*" -v http://18.242.143.10:4569
*   Trying 18.242.143.10:4569...
* Connected to 18.242.143.10 (18.242.143.10) port 4569 (#0)
&gt; GET / HTTP/1.1
&gt; Host: 18.242.143.10:4569
&gt; User-Agent: curl/7.76.1
&gt; Accept: */*
&gt;
* Mark bundle as not supporting multiuse
&lt; HTTP/1.1 200 OK
&lt; Content-Type: text/plain
&lt; Connection: close
&lt; Content-Length: 32
&lt;
Galera cluster node is not synced.
</code></pre>
<p>haproxy 也提供了 web 展示接口。galera 集群健康时，haproxy 有状态如图：<br>
<img data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1485868/202511/1485868-20251118231838845-1953227938.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>有 mariadb backup 节点离线时，haproxy 有状态如图：<br>
<img data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1485868/202511/1485868-20251118231851708-2020508946.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>如果是 mariadb master 节点离线，haproxy 会从 backup 中选择一个作为新 master。</p>
<h4 id="keepalived保障haproxy高可用">keepalived保障haproxy高可用</h4>
<p>keepalived 的配置：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">$ cat keepalived/keepalived.conf
vrrp_script check_alive {
    script "/check_alive.sh"
    interval 2
    fall 2
    rise 10
}

vrrp_instance kolla_internal_vip_51 {
    state BACKUP
    nopreempt
    interface ens3
    virtual_router_id 51
    priority 1
    advert_int 1
    virtual_ipaddress {
        18.242.143.100 dev ens3
    }
    authentication {
        auth_type PASS
        auth_pass gc7dzrgn3kjpRLLVK78aqcgR6aJNeakZzLajGPIz
    }
    track_script {
        check_alive
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>check_alive.sh 将 /checks 目录下发现的 check* 脚本循环执行一遍。check_alive_haproxy.sh 通过 socat 检查 haproxy 状态。其中：/var/lib/kolla/haproxy/haproxy.sock 是 haproxy 监听的 unix_socket，用于返回 haproxy 的状态信息。</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">$ cat keepalived/checks/check_alive_haproxy.sh
#!/bin/bash

# This will return 0 when it successfully talks to the haproxy daemon via the socket
# Failures return 1

echo "show info" | socat unix-connect:/var/lib/kolla/haproxy/haproxy.sock stdio &gt; /dev/null
</code></pre>
<p>当浮动IP所在节点的 haproxy 离线时，浮动IP切换到集群其它节点，不影响针对 galera 集群的查询</p>
<h3 id="haproxy的不足">haproxy的不足</h3>
<p>haproxy 可以对 galera 集群实现流量负载均衡，但是：</p>
<ul>
<li>一主多备模式，读写流量都在主节点。主节点可能负载过大</li>
<li>配置多主模式，读写流量按负载算法分配。多节点并发写，可能会造成 galera 集群写冲突</li>
</ul>
<p>所以，为了避免冲突，kolla 默认将 haproxy 配置为一主多备模式代理 galera 集群。</p>
<p>haproxy 代理的是四层流量，无法实现 sql 层次的解析。如果想要减轻主节点的读负担，实现读水平扩展，同时解决多节点写的冲突问题，需要使用 sql 级别的负载均衡方案。</p>
<h2 id="proxysql代理的galera集群">proxysql代理的galera集群</h2>
<h3 id="什么是proxysql">什么是proxysql</h3>
<p>ProxySQL 是一个高性能的 MySQL/MariaDB 中间层代理，实现 SQL 流量的转发、读写分离和负载均衡。如下是一个 mariadb 主从模式集群的 sql 流量读写分离示意图。</p>
<div align="center">
<img data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1485868/202511/1485868-20251118232059258-1212705814.png" class="lazyload">
</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>特性</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>连接池</td>
<td>应用连接 ProxySQL，ProxySQL 维护和数据库的连接池，减少数据库连接开销</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>读写分离</td>
<td>根据正则、Digest(SQL 指纹)规则匹配 SQL 语句(SELECT、INSERT、UPDATE)，并将识别后的 sql 路由到不同的节点</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>负载均衡</td>
<td>支持向多个后端节点按权重或策略分发请求</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>高可用与自动故障转移</td>
<td>内置后端 mariadb 节点健康检查机制，自动驱逐离线节点</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>kolla 支持 proxysql 部署，但是 <strong>proxysql</strong> 的配置较为复杂。</p>
<h3 id="kolla-proxysql-galera环境节点信息">kolla proxysql-galera环境节点信息</h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>节点</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>18.242.143.60</td>
<td>control-1</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>18.242.143.61</td>
<td>control-2</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>18.242.143.62</td>
<td>control-3</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>18.242.143.69</td>
<td>floating ip, control-3</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="kolla-proxysql-galera框架">kolla proxysql-galera框架</h3>
<h4 id="proxysql-galera的框架配置">proxysql-galera的框架配置</h4>
<p>kolla 部署的 openstack，proxysql 默认 disable。打开 proxysql，将有配置如下：</p>
<ul>
<li>neutron-server组件本身有关数据库访问的配置</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell">[database]
connection = mysql+pymysql://neutron:aYNsc0NKcGKDvhyYEQiiibGp18r6YhJRl9722sSv@18.242.143.69:3306/neutron
connection_recycle_time = 10
max_pool_size = 1
max_retries = -1
</code></pre>
<p>3306端口不再是 haproxy 代理，而是 proxysql 代理。</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">$ netstat -ntpl | grep 3306
tcp        0      0 18.242.143.62:3306      0.0.0.0:*               LISTEN      267014/mariadbd
tcp        0      0 18.242.143.69:3306      0.0.0.0:*               LISTEN      3809645/proxysql
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>
<p>proxysql 代理用户配置</p>
<ul>
<li>每个需要访问数据库的 openstack 组件都是一个用户</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">$ cat proxysql/users/neutron.yaml
mysql_users:
  - username: "neutron"
    password: "aYNsc0NKcGKDvhyYEQiiibGp18r6YhJRl9722sSv"  # 与neutron-server组件配置的数据库密码一致
    transaction_persistent: 1
    active: 1

$ cat proxysql/users/cinder.yaml
mysql_users:
  - username: "cinder"
    password: "12Nwlivw0rV7QmJPoOXKdwI5gC66B3c7vKuB6poH"  # 与cinder组件配置的数据库密码一致
    transaction_persistent: 1
    active: 1
......
......
......
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>只有被配置的用户才有权限通过 proxysql 访问后端数据库，否则会被拒绝。例如:</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell">Database error: (1045, "ProxySQL Error: Access denied for user 'root')
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>用户配置</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">$ ll -lh proxysql/users/
-rw-rw----. 1 root root 719 Jul 23 10:09 cinder.yaml
-rw-rw----. 1 root root 719 Jul 23 10:09 glance.yaml
-rw-rw----. 1 root root 720 Jul 23 10:09 gnocchi.yaml
-rw-rw----. 1 root root 717 Jul 23 10:10 heat.yaml
-rw-rw----. 1 root root 720 Jul 23 10:10 horizon.yaml
-rw-rw----. 1 root root 721 Jul 23 10:10 keystone.yaml
-rw-rw----. 1 root root 719 Jul 23 10:10 manila.yaml
-rw-rw----. 1 root root 750 Jul 23 10:10 mariadb.yaml
-rw-rw----. 1 root root 720 Jul 23 10:11 neutron.yaml
-rw-rw----. 1 root root 717 Jul 23 10:11 nova-cell.yaml
-rw-rw----. 1 root root 843 Jul 23 10:11 nova.yaml
-rw-rw----. 1 root root 722 Jul 23 10:11 placement.yaml
</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
<p>在 proxysql 生效的用户配置：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">MySQL [(none)]&gt; SELECT * FROM mysql_users;

| neutron      | aYNsc0NKcGKDvhyYEQiiibGp18r6YhJRl9722sSv | 1      | 0       | 0                 |                | 0             | 1                      | 0            | 1       | 1        | 10000           |            |         |
| placement    | kkboyBeKF3mMUCtB8Iv5rwdsvg3ANAAq8Ah165Ep | 1      | 0       | 0                 |                | 0             | 1                      | 0            | 1       | 1        | 10000           |            |         |
| nova         | db8uFbJtZ8QUODB1l6bV2JWUHpELHi2RPLfUuuTe | 1      | 0       | 0                 |                | 0             | 1                      | 0            | 1       | 1        | 10000           |            |         |
| nova_api     | o8zpPMvglwzFkCEsZ8Q7qVXr1WSVCoTqHxg1uvzo | 1      | 0       | 0                 |                | 0             | 1                      | 0            | 1       | 1        | 10000           |            |         |
+--------------+------------------------------------------+--------+---------+-------------------+----------------+---------------+------------------------+--------------+---------+----------+-----------------+------------+---------+

</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>proxysql.yaml 主体配置
<ul>
<li>hostgroup 0 定义为写组；hostgroup 1 定义为备写组；hostgroup 2 定义为读组；hostgroup 3 定义为离线组</li>
<li>writer_is_also_reader: 0，表示写节点不支持读</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">$ cat proxysql/proxysql.yaml
datadir: "/var/lib/proxysql"
errorlog: "/var/log/kolla/proxysql/proxysql.log"

admin_variables:
   admin_credentials: "kolla-admin:Do65z48HMsERpGWCec1Iv3Wpwjq4jfNR35l0HTAr"
   mysql_ifaces: "18.242.143.61:6032;18.242.143.69:6032;/var/lib/kolla/proxysql/admin.sock"
   stats_credentials: "kolla-stats:KtLqNzv1Rrsahz0XIdxxbSOjzLdH62soihO5T86i"

mysql_variables:
   threads: 5
   max_connections: 40000
   interfaces: "18.242.143.69:3306"     # proxysql 监听地址
   monitor_username: "monitor"
   monitor_password: "ITlG70FfcqE14RFjj14kv0PfoW5UfDguiuysncfK"

mysql_servers:
  - address: "18.242.143.62"
    port :  3306
    hostgroup :  0              # write group
    max_connections: 10000
    max_replication_lag: 0
    weight :  100
  - address: "18.242.143.60"
    port :  3306
    hostgroup :  1              # backup write group
    max_connections: 10000
    max_replication_lag: 0
    weight :  100
  - address: "18.242.143.61"
    port :  3306
    hostgroup :  1              # backup write group
    max_connections: 10000
    max_replication_lag: 0
    weight :  100
  - address: "18.242.143.60"
    port :  3306
    hostgroup :  2              # read group
    max_connections: 10000
    max_replication_lag: 0
    weight :  100
  - address: "18.242.143.61"
    port :  3306
    hostgroup :  2              # read group
    max_connections: 10000
    max_replication_lag: 0
    weight :  100

mysql_galera_hostgroups:
  - writer_hostgroup: 0         # write group ID
    backup_writer_hostgroup: 1  # baciup write group ID
    reader_hostgroup: 2         # read group ID
    offline_hostgroup: 3        # offline group ID
    max_connections: 10000
    max_writers: 1
    writer_is_also_reader: 0    # read group
    comment: "Galera cluster for shard 0"
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>proxysql 规则配置</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">$ cat proxysql/rules.bak/neutron.yaml
mysql_query_rules:
  - schemaname: "neutron"
    destination_hostgroup: 0
    apply: 1
    active: 1

$ cat proxysql/rules.bak/cinder.yaml
mysql_query_rules:
  - schemaname: "cinder"
    destination_hostgroup: 0
    apply: 1
    active: 1

......
......
......
</code></pre>
<h4 id="proxysql-galera默认配置的工作机制">proxysql-galera默认配置的工作机制</h4>
<p>kolla 默认配置会将所有组件的 <strong>读/写</strong> sql 流量都分发到 <strong>hostgroup: 0</strong> 的写组单节点。这一点与 haproxy 没有本质区别，都是将流量分发到了 galera 集群主节点。</p>
<ul>
<li>proxysql 节点运行信息
<ul>
<li>只有 mariadb 节点 18.242.143.62 在写组，且状态是：ONLINE</li>
<li>状态 <strong>SHUNNED</strong> 表示不适合接收请求。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell">MySQL [(none)]&gt; SELECT * FROM mysql_servers;
+--------------+---------------+------+-----------+--------+--------+-------------+-----------------+---------------------+---------+----------------+---------+
| hostgroup_id | hostname      | port | gtid_port | status | weight | compression | max_connections | max_replication_lag | use_ssl | max_latency_ms | comment |
+--------------+---------------+------+-----------+--------+--------+-------------+-----------------+---------------------+---------+----------------+---------+
| 0            | 18.242.143.62 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 1            | 18.242.143.60 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 1            | 18.242.143.61 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 2            | 18.242.143.60 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 2            | 18.242.143.61 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
+--------------+---------------+------+-----------+--------+--------+-------------+-----------------+---------------------+---------+----------------+---------+
5 rows in set (0.002 sec)

MySQL [(none)]&gt;
MySQL [(none)]&gt; SELECT * FROM runtime_mysql_servers;
+--------------+---------------+------+-----------+---------+--------+-------------+-----------------+---------------------+---------+----------------+---------+
| hostgroup_id | hostname      | port | gtid_port | status  | weight | compression | max_connections | max_replication_lag | use_ssl | max_latency_ms | comment |
+--------------+---------------+------+-----------+---------+--------+-------------+-----------------+---------------------+---------+----------------+---------+
| 0            | 18.242.143.60 | 3306 | 0         | SHUNNED | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 0            | 18.242.143.61 | 3306 | 0         | SHUNNED | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 0            | 18.242.143.62 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE  | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 1            | 18.242.143.60 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE  | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 1            | 18.242.143.61 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE  | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
+--------------+---------------+------+-----------+---------+--------+-------------+-----------------+---------------------+---------+----------------+---------+
5 rows in set (0.003 sec)
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>proxysql 的运行规则
<ul>
<li>match_digest(摘要匹配，忽略参数值)，match_pattern(完整文本匹配，包括参数) 都为 NULL</li>
<li>destination_hostgroup 都为 0，表示将所有schemaname的请求，都代理至写组，即 online 的 18.242.143.62 节点</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell">MySQL [(none)]&gt; SELECT rule_id, schemaname, match_digest, match_pattern, destination_hostgroup, apply, active, comment FROM runtime_mysql_query_rules;
+---------+------------+--------------+---------------+-----------------------+-------+--------+---------+
| rule_id | schemaname | match_digest | match_pattern | destination_hostgroup | apply | active | comment |
+---------+------------+--------------+---------------+-----------------------+-------+--------+---------+
| 1       | gnocchi    | NULL         | NULL          | 0                     | 1     | 1      | NULL    |
| 2       | heat       | NULL         | NULL          | 0                     | 1     | 1      | NULL    |
| 3       | nova       | NULL         | NULL          | 0                     | 1     | 1      | NULL    |
| 4       | nova_cell0 | NULL         | NULL          | 0                     | 1     | 1      | NULL    |
| 5       | nova_api   | NULL         | NULL          | 0                     | 1     | 1      | NULL    |
| 6       | horizon    | NULL         | NULL          | 0                     | 1     | 1      | NULL    |
| 7       | keystone   | NULL         | NULL          | 0                     | 1     | 1      | NULL    |
| 8       | neutron    | NULL         | NULL          | 0                     | 1     | 1      | NULL    |
| 9       | cinder     | NULL         | NULL          | 0                     | 1     | 1      | NULL    |
| 10      | glance     | NULL         | NULL          | 0                     | 1     | 1      | NULL    |
| 11      | manila     | NULL         | NULL          | 0                     | 1     | 1      | NULL    |
| 12      | placement  | NULL         | NULL          | 0                     | 1     | 1      | NULL    |
+---------+------------+--------------+---------------+-----------------------+-------+--------+---------+
12 rows in set (0.002 sec)
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>sql路由确认</li>
</ul>
<p>所有sql语句（无论是读还是写）都被路由到了 hostgroup = 0 的节点：18.242.143.62</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">MySQL [(none)]&gt; SELECT hostgroup, username, count_star, SUBSTRING(digest_text, 1, 180) AS digest_text_short FROM stats_mysql_query_digest;

| 0         | neutron   | 54         | SELECT subnetroutes.destination AS subnetroutes_destination,subnetroutes.nexthop AS subnetroutes_nexthop,subnetroutes.subnet_id AS subnetroutes_subnet_id,subnets_1.id AS subnets_1_ |
| 0         | neutron   | 54         | SELECT dnsnameservers.address AS dnsnameservers_address,dnsnameservers.subnet_id AS dnsnameservers_subnet_id,dnsnameservers.`order` AS dnsnameservers_order,subnets_1.id AS subnets_ |
| 0         | neutron   | 54         | SELECT tags.standard_attr_id AS tags_standard_attr_id,tags.tag AS tags_tag,standardattributes_1.id AS standardattributes_1_id FROM (SELECT networks.id AS networks_id FROM networks  |

<h4 id="proxysql-galera请求路径">proxysql-galera请求路径</h4>
<p>openstack 的 proxysql-galera 环境，各应用对 galera 集群的访问演变为如下图所示：</p>
<div align="center">
<img data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1485868/202511/1485868-20251118232157207-1961330868.png" class="lazyload">
</div>
<ul>
<li>相对于 haproxy-galera，只是第 ⑦ 步变为了组件对 proxysql 的访问</li>
<li>所有读写请求都调度到了 galera 集群主节点 mariadb-1，没有实现读写分离。效果其实跟haproxy类似</li>
</ul>
<p>问题的根本原因在于 galera 默认配置：<strong>read_only = OFF</strong>，以及 proxysql：<strong>writer_is_also_reader = 0</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>galera 集群默认所有节点都可读可写，所有 galera 节点只读标识默认为 read_only = OFF</li>
<li>proxysql 虽然配置了 18.242.143.60 和 18.242.143.61 在读组，但是 proxsql 的 runtime_mysql_servers 表里并不存在任何读节点。因为 proxysql 和后端 mariadb 节点协商时，只有节点 read_only = ON，该节点才能被加入到读组。但 galera 集群却默认都是 read_only = OFF，所以没有节点被加入到读组</li>
<li>proxysql 的 writer_is_also_reader = 0 表示 mariadb 写节点不可读。但是 proxysql 为了容错，所有读请求还是会被默认送到galera集群主节点</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="proxysql-galera半读写分离单写所有节点读">proxysql-galera半读写分离（单写，所有节点读）</h4>
<p>需要 <strong>writer_is_also_reader = 1</strong>，以及配合sql路由规则配合。</p>
<ul>
<li>写节点同时可读，此时 proxysql 不再检查 mariadb 节点的 read_only 标识，因此 galera 集群所有节点都会被添加到读组：<strong>hostgroup: 2</strong></li>
<li>proxysql 只配置了一个节点为写，所以只有主节点 18.242.143.62 在写组</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-shell">MySQL [(none)]&gt; SELECT * FROM runtime_mysql_servers;
+--------------+---------------+------+-----------+---------+--------+-------------+-----------------+---------------------+---------+----------------+---------+
| hostgroup_id | hostname      | port | gtid_port | status  | weight | compression | max_connections | max_replication_lag | use_ssl | max_latency_ms | comment |
+--------------+---------------+------+-----------+---------+--------+-------------+-----------------+---------------------+---------+----------------+---------+
| 0            | 18.242.143.60 | 3306 | 0         | SHUNNED | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 0            | 18.242.143.61 | 3306 | 0         | SHUNNED | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 0            | 18.242.143.62 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE  | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 1            | 18.242.143.60 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE  | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 1            | 18.242.143.61 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE  | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 2            | 18.242.143.60 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE  | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 2            | 18.242.143.61 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE  | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 2            | 18.242.143.62 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE  | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
+--------------+---------------+------+-----------+---------+--------+-------------+-----------------+---------------------+---------+----------------+---------+
8 rows in set (0.003 sec)
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>proxysql 配置相应 sql 路由规则</li>
</ul>
<p>任意组件的读请求路由到 hostgroup = 2 的读节点，写请求路由到 hostgroup = 0 的写节点。</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">MySQL [(none)]&gt; SELECT rule_id, schemaname, match_digest, match_pattern, destination_hostgroup, apply, active, comment FROM runtime_mysql_query_rules;

</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>半读写分离，proxysql 对后端 galera 集群的流量调度如下图
<ul>
<li>有节点都能分担读压力，资源充分利用</li>
<li>虽然 galera 理论上是同步复制，但在高并发场景下依然可能有写同步延迟。某些读请求存在读到旧数据的可能性</li>
<li>sql路由规则配置会比较麻烦，需要给每个应用配置复杂的 sql 读写路由规则</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<div align="center">
<img data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1485868/202511/1485868-20251118232321139-1012571238.png" class="lazyload">
</div>
<h4 id="proxysql-galera读写完全分离单写多读">proxysql-galera读写完全分离（单写，多读）</h4>
<p>不同于 mariadb 的主从集群（读节点天然是 read_only = ON），proxysql 对 galera 集群的支持并不友好。如果要在 galera 集群上实现 sql 流量的完全读写分离，需要：</p>
<ul>
<li>proxysql 设置 writer_is_also_reader = 0，保证主节点只写</li>
<li>其余节点作为读，设置 read_only = ON</li>
<li>需要引入新的机制，动态设置 galera 的读写角色（因为 proxysql 只能感知 mariadb 的节点角色，但是不能主动设置，需要一个新服务根据监控信息，去动态设置某个 mariadb 节点的角色）。例如写节点挂掉，自动挑选一个读节点转换为写节点；若写节点存在时，动态设置当前节点为“只读”角色。</li>
</ul>
<p>按上面的方法，实现完全读写分离，proxysql 有如下  galera 代理信息：主节点在写组，其余节点在读组</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">MySQL [(none)]&gt; SELECT * FROM runtime_mysql_servers;
+--------------+---------------+------+-----------+--------+--------+-------------+-----------------+---------------------+---------+----------------+---------+
| hostgroup_id | hostname      | port | gtid_port | status | weight | compression | max_connections | max_replication_lag | use_ssl | max_latency_ms | comment |
+--------------+---------------+------+-----------+--------+--------+-------------+-----------------+---------------------+---------+----------------+---------+
| 0            | 18.242.143.62 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 2            | 18.242.143.60 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 2            | 18.242.143.61 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
+--------------+---------------+------+-----------+--------+--------+-------------+-----------------+---------------------+---------+----------------+---------+
3 rows in set (0.002 sec)
</code></pre>
<p>此时，有流量路径如下图所示：</p>
<div align="center">
<img data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1485868/202511/1485868-20251118232433671-1219698482.png" class="lazyload">
</div>
<p>mariadb 角色监控服务，需要具备角色监控和设置能力。例如监控到 mariadb-1，18.242.143.62 写节点离线，通过设置其余 mariadb 读节点角色（自动挑选 18.242.143.61 为新的写节点，修改 18.242.143.61 节点 mariadb 的 read_only = ON 为 OFF），proxysql 感知到 18.242.143.61 节点的角色变化后, 最终重新选举出18.242.143.61为新的 写 节点。</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">MySQL [(none)]&gt; SELECT * FROM runtime_mysql_servers;
+--------------+---------------+------+-----------+---------+--------+-------------+-----------------+---------------------+---------+----------------+---------+
| hostgroup_id | hostname      | port | gtid_port | status  | weight | compression | max_connections | max_replication_lag | use_ssl | max_latency_ms | comment |
+--------------+---------------+------+-----------+---------+--------+-------------+-----------------+---------------------+---------+----------------+---------+
| 0            | 18.242.143.61 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE  | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 2            | 18.242.143.60 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE  | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 3            | 18.242.143.62 | 3306 | 0         | SHUNNED | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
+--------------+---------------+------+-----------+---------+--------+-------------+-----------------+---------------------+---------+----------------+---------+
3 rows in set (0.005 sec)
</code></pre>
<p>总之，proxysql 对 galera 集群并不友好，实现完全读写分离需要自主实现 <strong>mariadb 角色监控服务</strong>。</p>
<p>读写完全分离更适合 mariadb 主从模式（读节点天然是 read_only = ON）。半读写分离，已经是 kolla proxysql-galera 改动最小，代价最低的方案。</p>
<h3 id="proxysql高可用">proxysql高可用</h3>
<h4 id="proxysql对mariadb的健康检查">proxysql对mariadb的健康检查</h4>
<p>跟 haproxy类似，proxysql 内部也集成了对后端 mariadb 节点的健康检查。</p>
<p>例如 kolla proxysql 默认的读写不分离场景，主 mariadb 节点健康时，proxysql 有视图信息:</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">MySQL [(none)]&gt; SELECT * FROM runtime_mysql_servers;
+--------------+---------------+------+-----------+---------+--------+-------------+-----------------+---------------------+---------+----------------+---------+
| hostgroup_id | hostname      | port | gtid_port | status  | weight | compression | max_connections | max_replication_lag | use_ssl | max_latency_ms | comment |
+--------------+---------------+------+-----------+---------+--------+-------------+-----------------+---------------------+---------+----------------+---------+
| 0            | 18.242.143.60 | 3306 | 0         | SHUNNED | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 0            | 18.242.143.61 | 3306 | 0         | SHUNNED | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 0            | 18.242.143.62 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE  | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 1            | 18.242.143.60 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE  | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 1            | 18.242.143.61 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE  | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
+--------------+---------------+------+-----------+---------+--------+-------------+-----------------+---------------------+---------+----------------+---------+
5 rows in set (0.003 sec)
</code></pre>
<p>主节点 18.242.143.62 离线后进入了离线组，18.242.143.61 成为了新读写节点：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">+--------------+---------------+------+-----------+---------+--------+-------------+-----------------+---------------------+---------+----------------+---------+
| hostgroup_id | hostname      | port | gtid_port | status  | weight | compression | max_connections | max_replication_lag | use_ssl | max_latency_ms | comment |
+--------------+---------------+------+-----------+---------+--------+-------------+-----------------+---------------------+---------+----------------+---------+
| 0            | 18.242.143.60 | 3306 | 0         | SHUNNED | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 0            | 18.242.143.61 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE  | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 1            | 18.242.143.60 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE  | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
| 3            | 18.242.143.62 | 3306 | 0         | ONLINE  | 100    | 0           | 10000           | 0                   | 0       | 0              |         |
+--------------+---------------+------+-----------+---------+--------+-------------+-----------------+---------------------+---------+----------------+---------+
</code></pre>
<h4 id="keepalived保障proxysql高可用">keepalived保障proxysql高可用</h4>
<p>也跟 haproxy 类似，启用 proxysql 后，keepalived 会新增一个面向 proxysql 健康检查的脚本：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">$ ll keepalived/checks/
total 8
-rwxrwx---. 1 root root 211 Jul 23 10:08 check_alive_haproxy.sh
-rwxrwx---. 1 root root 210 Jul 23 10:08 check_alive_proxysql.sh
$
$ cat keepalived/checks/check_alive_proxysql.sh
#!/bin/bash

# This will return 0 when it successfully talks to the ProxySQL daemon via localhost
# Failures return 1

echo "show info" | socat unix-connect:/var/lib/kolla/proxysql/admin.sock stdio &gt; /dev/null
</code></pre>
<p>/var/lib/kolla/proxysql/admin.sock，是 proxysql 监听的 unix_socket。当浮动IP所在节点的 proxysql 离线时，浮动IP切换到集群其它节点，不影响针对 galera 集群的查询。</p>
<h1 id="总结">总结</h1>
<ul>
<li>kolla 默认 mairadb 多节点为 galera 集群，还是为了使用 galera 的多节点可同时读写，同步复制，以及强一致性特性，为了避免写冲突，kolla 默认 openstack 应用都向同一个节点写。不管是 haproxy 还是 proxysql</li>
<li>galera 集群也不是越大越好，节点数越多，一致性开销就会越大，一般3-5个节点合适</li>
<li>haproxy 对 galera 集群支持 4 层代理，但是对 7 层支持还不够</li>
<li>proxysql 可以支持 sql 路由，但是对 galera 的支持不够。想要 sql 完整读写分离，需要引入新的机制自动设置 mariadb 节点角色，在 mariadb 写节点离线时，使得 <strong>proxysql</strong> 可以选出新的写节点，保障 galera 高可用</li>
</ul>
